title: Home-Mandate relay operator metadata v0
description: Parameters of a relay operator, published at https://<operator-domain>/.well-known/home-mandate-relay (RELAY-v0 Section 3). Draft, not part of v0.1.0 of the Home-Mandate Specification. Rules that a schema cannot express (operator_domain equals the host the document was fetched from, name_domain differs from operator_domain, enrollment is on the operator domain or below) are in RELAY-v0 Section 3.

relay_pins.description: SHA-256 digests of SubjectPublicKeyInfo, base64url without padding; at least two, so that one key can be replaced (RELAY-v0 Section 6).

max_offline_days.description: Days after the expiry of the last tunnel certificate during which the installation key alone authenticates a re-issuance (RELAY-v0 Section 5.4). RECOMMENDED: 30.

protection_levels.description: Both levels are mandatory for every operator (RELAY-v0 Section 7).

domain.description: Lower-case DNS name with at least two labels, without a trailing dot or a port. For trust_domain this is stricter than SPIFFE, which also allows single labels and underscores.

https_url.description: HTTPS URL with a lower-case DNS host, an optional port, a path of unreserved characters and no user info, query, fragment or percent-encoding.
